chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb, from 'Abd al-Ghaffar al-Harithi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The menstruating woman may recite whatever she wishes from the Qur'an.
ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman recite the Qur'an according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a menstruating woman is permitted to recite from the Qur'an as much as she wishes. It is significant in discussions of ritual purity and the jurisprudential limits, if any, on Qur'an recitation during menstruation.
